description: This file defines the ResultInterface in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a result object returned from AWS operations. It specifies the methods for converting the result to a string or array, checking for keys, retrieving key values, and searching with JMESPath expressions.

classes.name: ResultInterface
classes.description: An interface representing an AWS result object with methods for interacting with the result data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides debug information about the result object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the result object into an array.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if the model contains a specified key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific key from the result.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Applies a JMESPath expression to the result contents to extract specific data.
